summary.title: Add FreeStyle Libre 3/3+ support
changes: FreeStyle Libre 3/3+ appears as a new 'beta' option in the CGM picker.
Trio can pair FreeStyle Libre 3/3+ sensors directly as an experimental plugin without a companion app.
The home glucose view now shows sensor lifecycle details: progress arc, warmup countdown, and status tags/icons.
LibreLoop sensor alerts are routed into Trio and delivered as time‑sensitive notifications.
